senses.gloss: f. (דוק) the examination of family records required for pure marriages (v. בָּדַק); in gen. family record.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:15">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>דזקיף … בדְיוּקְתֵּיה וכ׳</he>, quot.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 349">Yalk. Ex. 349</cite> (ed. <he>בדיותקיה</he>, Ms. M. <he>בריסתקי</he>, Ms. H. <he>בדוּקְתֵּיה</he>, Ms. F. <he>בדותקיה</he>, &c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if there is a case of hanging in one’s family record, say not to him, Hang this fish up for me. [Sh’ilt. d’R. Aḥai s. 41 has three times <he>דוקתא</he>, s. 153 <he>דותקא</he>. For the etymol. of <cite ref="D00546"><he>דיותקא</he></cite>, <he>דות׳</he>, v. Perl. Et. St. p. 80.]
